findings.text: The company was incorporated on 15 September 2021 and was 3.1 years old at cessation.
One insolvency case is on record: a creditors voluntary liquidation, with the company wound up on 21 November 2023 and dissolved on 29 October 2024.
The company has 1 current officer, a director, PERSON 311, who was appointed on 15 September 2021.
The accounts are of unknown overdue status, with no next due date recorded; the last accounts were made up to 30 September 2022.
The confirmation statement is of unknown overdue status, with no next due date recorded; the last statement was made up to 14 September 2023.
One current person with significant control is recorded: PERSON 312, an individual with 75 to 100 percent ownership of shares and voting rights and the right to appoint and remove directors.
The director, PERSON 311, has 2 other appointments, both to companies that are dissolved.
No charges are registered against the company.
